status: fixed before generating or evaluating new scenes; no post-result model/checkpoint/threshold selection
purpose: One fixed-candidate fresh same-generator synthetic holdout, not natural-image, out-of-distribution or production acceptance
runner_note: Only add evaluation-role provenance and a fresh-role training prohibition; existence features, head, routing, metrics, data generator and original localization unchanged
decision: fixed argmax, no threshold fit, equal costs in already-trained head; uncalibrated logits
data_policy: Each fixed seed generates 100 scenes using unchanged generator; evaluate only its fresh validation partition (10 images,40 questions). Generated train/test partitions are unused, not training sources. Original multiscene-dev-v1 test remains locked and uninferred.
independent_units: 50 new images; positive and negative image/phrase decisions are paired within each image, each duplicated across point/box. Do not treat 200 questions as 200 independent images.
leakage_policy: Before inference require all new image hashes disjoint from every old multiscene-dev-v1 partition and from other shards; fail without reseeding if collision. Namespace scene/question IDs by shard in combined metrics because generator-local IDs repeat across seeds.
locked_test_policy: Record original test.jsonl SHA256 before and after; no model inference on original test or any new generated train/test partition
comparison: same new inputs, frozen original localizer vs fixed external gate; keep all failures and all five shards

predeclared_research_screen.note: A conservative research screen chosen before new data, not a statistical noninferiority test, business safety budget or deployment authorization

uncertainty: Descriptive Wilson95 intervals for binary presence recall and absence specificity after collapsing identical point/box decisions; n=50 for each, assuming independent same-generator image draws. No binomial CI on 200 correlated question-level answers.
independent_recheck: Re-run shard01 once in a separate process with the same head and compare every baseline, gate/logit and routed row. No retry/reselection on a poor score.
